_doc: Phrase library. symbols = { name: [entry] }. entry = string | { t: template, tags: [...], w: weight, cond: 'js expression', bind: { key: { type, tags } } }. Symbols starting with _ are helpers, never intents. Tone: dark fantasy, RimWorld-style colonists who can die. Combat lines carry two extra tag families so one pool serves everybody: enemy kind (goblin, bandit, cultist, undead, demon, void, dragon, knight) and hero role (tank, healer, caster, rogue, ranger). A speaker's speech.tagWeights turns the ones that don't apply to 0 (see prototypes/emberveil/js/talk.js). Anti-repeat: Lingo keeps a per-symbol session history, so a pool of 12+ never repeats inside one session.

intentDoc.gossip: about a third person or faction
intentDoc.question: asks the listener something
intentDoc.observe: comment on the current scene (needs scene bindings)
intentDoc.observe_person: say what the speaker thinks of the listener (relationship factors)
intentDoc.reveal: mention something the speaker has learned about the listener (knowledge)
intentDoc.recall_deed: an NPC acknowledges a deed of the hero (memory type deed)
intentDoc.recall_nemesis: a named enemy that beat, escaped or fell to the party (memory type nemesis)
intentDoc.recall_conversation: callback to something the listener said at a previous camp (memory type conversation)
intentDoc.enemy_opener: enemy's first line of a fight (tag by kind: goblin/bandit/cultist/undead/demon/void/dragon/knight)
intentDoc.boss_opener: boss's first line of a fight
intentDoc.boss_phase: boss line when it changes phase mid-fight
intentDoc.named_first: named enemy meeting the party for the first time
intentDoc.named_rematch: named enemy that has met the party before (bindings: defeats, days)
intentDoc.named_avenge: named enemy that has already put one of the party down (binding: fallen)
intentDoc.named_beaten: named enemy the party has beaten before (binding: defeats)
intentDoc.named_beast: narration for a named beast that cannot speak (binding: foe)
intentDoc.beast_snarl: narration when a wordless beast opens a fight (binding: foe)
intentDoc.night_attack: narration when something hits the camp at night (binding: foe)
intentDoc.ambush_opener: narration when the party is ambushed on the road

meta.noRepeatDoc: Symbols with a hard session anti-repeat: Lingo will not reuse an entry while it is inside the last sessionRecentSize (20) picks for that symbol, across every speaker. Combat lines live here because a party of four opening 30 fights used to reach for the same high-weight taunt over and over.

bodyharm.t: open you from throat to belt

weathertalk.t: at least the {$weather} keeps the {$creature.pl} away
I've seen worse {$weather}, but not by much

worktalk.t: the {$place} needs {~shoring up|clearing|a new roof|burning down}
three days on the {$place} and my {$bodypart.pl} are done

greet.t: {#greetword}, {listener.name}. Good to see you still breathing.
{#greetword}. I'd say it's good to see you, {listener.name}, but we both know I'd be lying.
{#greetword}, {listener.name}. Come, sit. The fire's warm and the {$food} is {~almost|nearly|technically} hot.
{#greetword}, {listener.name}. I was just thinking of you. {~Not kindly.|Fondly, for once.|Mostly about what you owe me.}
{listener.name}. {~I have a bad feeling about today.|Something's wrong. I can smell it.}
{#greetword}, {listener.name}. Have you eaten? You should eat.
{#greetword}, {listener.name}. I trust {$faction} hasn't hanged anyone yet today.
{#greetword}, {listener.name}. I haven't forgotten what you did for me.
{#greetword}. {listener.name}. I'd say more, but I'd want to mean it.
{#greetword}. Do I know you? No. Should I?

greet_reply.t: Alive. That's the most I'll claim.
Same as ever. Nothing changes here except the dead.
Don't 'hello' me. Where were you last night?
{#greetword}. I'll be honest, I hoped it was someone else.
Oh! {listener.name}. You startled me. Sorry. Sorry.
{#greetword}. Is it true about {$person}? Never mind. Later.

farewell.t: {#farewellword}, {listener.name}. Watch the {$place} road; {$creature.pl} have been seen.
{#farewellword}. Try not to bleed on anything I own.
{#farewellword}, {listener.name}. We'll speak again, if the {$weather} lets us.
Go. Before I change my mind about you.
That's enough talk. Talk doesn't fill bellies.

smalltalk.t: Quiet today. Too quiet. I don't trust it.
Heard a {$creature} in the night. Or a {$creature2}. Either way, I didn't sleep.
{$person} says the {$weather} will break by {#timeofday}. {$person} says a lot of things.
Another day above ground. That's a good day.
Did you see the sky over {$place}? Red as a butcher's apron.
My {$bodypart} aches when the {$weather} comes. Old wound. Older than you.
Nothing to report. Nothing ever is, until it's too late.
The {$item} I bought off {$person} broke already. Never buy from a {$person.race.sg}.
We should fix the {$place} before the {$weather} gets worse.
You ever wonder what {$deity} makes of all this? No? Just me, then.
I found {$item.a} in the mud. Somebody's, once. Nobody's now.
Counted the stores again. We'll last the month. Probably.
Saw a {$creature} the size of a cart out past the {$place}. Didn't stay to measure.

gossip.t: Heard {$person} got caught with {$item.a} that wasn't theirs.
{$person} hasn't been the same since {$place}. Nobody says it, but we all see it.
They say {$faction} is recruiting. Paying in {$item.pl}, if you believe it.
{$person} and {$person2}? Oh, everyone knows. Everyone except {$person2}.
Don't trust {$person}. I've seen {$person.them} talking to {$faction}.
{$person} drank a whole cask of {$food} and fought a {$creature}. Lost. Badly.
Word is {$faction} lost {~half their people|a whole caravan|their leader} to the {$creature.pl} near {$place}.
{$person} prays to {$deity} now. Since the funeral. Can't blame {$person.them}.
I'm not one to talk, but {$person} owes half of {$place} money.
They found {$person.poss} {$item} in the {$place}. Just the {$item}.
{$person} is a {#insultadj} {#insultnoun}, and I'll say it to {$person.their} face.
{$person} did right by me once. I don't forget that.
Between us: {$faction} is finished. The {$creature.pl} saw to that.
{$person} thinks {$person.they} can cast {$spell}. Watched {$person.them} try. We'll need a new {$place}.

lore.t: {$deity} made the {$race.pl} first, they say. {~Made them badly, too.|You'd not know it to look at them.|A first draft.}
{$spell.cap} was forbidden after {$concept}. There's a reason.
The {$race.pl} have a word for this {$weather}. It means 'the sky mourning'.
{$faction} once held every road from {$place} to {$place2}. Now they hold a ditch.
My people, {speaker.race.people}, have a saying: {~'the grave is patient'|'sharpen the blade, not the tongue'|'every debt is paid in the end'}.
There are older things than {$deity} under {$place}. Pray you never learn their names.
{$item.pl.cap} like this were made in {$place} before {$concept}. Nobody remembers how.
Every {$race.sg} child learns of {$concept}. Every {$race2.sg} child learns to blame us for it.
{$creature.pl.cap} weren't always this size. Something is feeding them.
In {lang_place}, the dead are not buried. They are asked to leave.
{$deity} does not answer. {~That is the answer.|Never has.|Perhaps that is mercy.}

question.t: Where were you when the {$creature.pl} came?
What would you do with {$item.a}, if you had one?
Have you ever killed {listener.race.a}? Your own kind?
Is it true you can cast {$spell}?
What's {$person} really like? You've known {$person.them} longest.
If you had to choose, {listener.name}: {$food} or {$food2}, for the rest of your life?
Who do you trust here? Name one.
How much for the {$item}? And don't say 'priceless'.

answer.t: {~That's a long story.|Ask me when I'm drunk.|Not here.}
Why do you want to know?
I could tell you, but then {$faction} would want a word.
I've thought about it every night since {$place}.
Ha! You'd have to pay me for that one.
{#oath.cap}, that's the first honest question anyone's asked me in a year.

compliment.t: You're {#praiseadj}, {listener.name}. Don't let it go to your head.
I'd want you beside me in {$place}. Not many I'd say that of.
You've got {~good hands|a steady eye|a hard head|a clean cut}, {listener.name}.
{listener.name}, you are the finest {listener.race.sg} I have had the honor to know.
You held the line when {$person} ran. I saw.
Anyone else would've left me in the {$place}. You didn't.
You cook {$food} better than my mother, and she was a {~witch|saint|professional}.
I trust you. I don't say that. I don't say it to anyone.

thanks.t: {#thanksword}. {~Don't expect it to happen again.|Don't tell anyone I said that.}
{#thanksword}. I'd have been {$creature} food without you.
{#thanksword}. How much do I owe you?
{#thanksword}. Keep the {$item}. Consider us square, and then some.
{#thanksword}. That's twice now. I keep count, {listener.name}.

insult.t: {listener.name}, you {#insultadj} {#insultnoun}, get out of my sight.
Your mother was a {$creature} and your father apologised to her.
I've scraped better than you off my {$item}.
Every {listener.race.sg} I ever met was a {#insultnoun}. You're no exception.
{$person} said you were a {#insultnoun}. I defended you. I was wrong.
Go cast {$spell} on yourself. See if it helps.
You are beneath contempt, and contempt is beneath me. So.
I'd call you a {#insultnoun}, but {#insultnoun.pl} have their uses.
Look at you. Just look at you.
You'd sell your own {$bodypart} to {$faction} for {$item.a}.
You're good with that {$item}, I'll give you that. Shame about everything else.
I'd insult you, but you'd have to understand it first.

retort.t: I've been called worse by better.
Is that all? {$person} does it better. Drunk.
You're right. And I hate you for it.
Ha! {#oath.cap}, you've got spine. I'll give you that.
I won't dignify that. I will remember it.
Careful. Last {#insultnoun} who spoke to me like that is feeding {$creature.pl}.
Fine. Fine! Everyone's against me. Fine.

threat.t: Touch my {$item} again. Go on. I want you to.
There's a shallow grave near {$place} with your name on it.
I have buried better {listener.race.pl} than you, and I did not weep.
One more word. One. And we'll see what {$deity} thinks of you.
I won't kill you. I'll just make sure you wish I had.
Run. Now. While you still can.
Leave, or I'll feed you to the {$creature.pl} a {$bodypart} at a time.
I'm warning you. I mean it. I do.

apology.t: I was wrong. There. Don't make me say it twice.
Forgive me. It was the {~ale|hunger|fear|{$weather}} talking.
I apologise. It was beneath me.
Sorry. Sorry, sorry. I didn't mean it. I never mean it.
I shouldn't have said that about your {$bodypart.pl}.
You deserved better from me. {$deity} knows I know it.
I was wrong to doubt you. You've earned better from me.

agree.t: {#yesword}. Couldn't have said it better. Wouldn't have tried.
Agreed. Let's not waste words on it.

disagree.t: {#noword}. And if you believe that, I've {$item.a} to sell you.
I... don't think that's right. But what do I know.
{#noword}, and I'll {#bodyharm} if you say it again.

complain.t: I'm starving. Actually starving. Not the pretty kind.
Haven't slept in {~two|three|four} days. The {$creature.pl} don't sleep, so why should I.
{$person} got the last of the {$food}. Again. Funny how that works.
My {$bodypart} still hasn't healed from {$place}. It won't, will it?
Work, eat {$food}, sleep in the {$weather}, work. That's the whole song.
{#curse.cap}. This {$item} is worthless. {$person} sold me scrap.
I miss {~real bread|hot water|a bed with legs|being warm}. Is that so much?
Nobody listens. I said the {$place} would flood. Did it flood? It flooded.
My feet. My back. My {$bodypart}. Pick one.
We're going to die here. I just wanted to say it out loud once.

brag.t: I once killed {~three|five|seven} {$creature.pl} with {$item.a}. A broken {$item}.
There isn't a {$race.sg} alive who can outdrink me.
{$faction} offered me command. I told them where to put it.
I've walked into {$place} and walked out. Twice.
They still sing of me in {$place}. Badly, but they sing.
I can cast {$spell} in my sleep. I have. Burned a {$place}.
I am the finest {speaker.title.or(warrior)} {speaker.race.people} ever produced, and I say that with humility.
Nothing scares me. Not {$creature.pl}, not {$deity}, not you.
I've made more coin in a season than {$person} will see in a life.
Did you see it? Tell me somebody saw it.
That is why I go first.
Not one of them got past me. Not one.
Nobody died. That was me, by the way.
Textbook. Absolutely textbook.
Three of them, if anyone's counting. I'm counting.
They never saw me. They never do.
Two arrows. Two.
Write this down. Somebody write this down.
I'd love to tell you that was hard.
That's the third fight I've carried this week.
Bury them facing the road. Let the next lot read it.
My {$item} hasn't even got warm.

work.t: Careful with that. {$person} lost a {$bodypart} to one.
Almost done. Then {$food}. Then sleep. Then this again.
My father did this work. His father too. All of them dead now, mind.
Sing something, {listener.name}. Anything but the one about {$place}.
{$deity} put us here to work, my mother said. She worked herself to death.
If {$faction} paid what they promised, I'd not be lifting this.
Good. Good. That'll hold till the next {$weather}.

flirt.t: You've got the kind of face I'd like to see more of, {listener.name}.
Walk with me after the {$weather} clears? Just walk.
If the {$creature.pl} come tonight, I'd want it to be beside you.
I saved you the last of the {$food}. Don't read into it. Read into it.
{listener.name}. Your {$bodypart.pl}. They're... I've been drinking. Never mind.
There's a poem in {speaker.race.lang} about eyes like yours. It ends badly, but the middle is lovely.
Marry me. Or don't. But share a fire with me tonight.
I'd fight {$faction} bare-handed for one evening with you.
You're trouble, {listener.name}. I've always liked trouble.

flirt_reply.t: I thought you'd never ask. I mean that. I was losing hope.
Ha. {#oath.cap}. Fine. But if you die on me, I'll never forgive you.

reject.t: I'm... not there. Not with anyone. Not since {$place}.
You're a good {listener.race.sg}. That's a no.
Ask me again when you've bathed.
{$deity} has my heart. There's no room.

combat_bark.t: I don't want to die here!
{$deity}, if you're watching, now would be good!
I won't fight! I won't! Just— stop!
On me! All of you, on me!
Don't you dare die on me!
Keep the line! Keep the line!
They want past me. Let them try.
Out of the smoke — I can't see you!
Don't crowd me, I need the room!
Don't look at me. Look at him.

combat_taunt.t: Is that all, {foe.sg}?
I've killed prettier {foe.pl} than you!
Your kind bleeds like everyone else, {foe.sg}.
Come closer. I'll {#bodyharm}!
{foe.pl.cap}! I'll wear your {$bodypart.pl} as a necklace!
You picked the wrong {speaker.race.sg}!
Please just go away. Please.
My {$item} is hungry, {foe.sg}. Feed it.
Go home, {foe.sg}. Nobody has to die here.
Everything that wants you comes through me first.
Hit me again. I'll wait.
You'll break on this shield like the last lot did.
Come on then, {foe.sg}. I'm the wall.
I mend what you break. You won't outlast that.
Every wound you open I close. Get tired.
{$deity.cap} is watching this. Behave accordingly.
I've read what happens to things like you. It's thorough.
You can't parry what I'm about to say.
{$spell.cap}. Learn the word — it's the last one you get.
You won't see the one that does it.
Keep shouting. It tells me exactly where you are.
I've already found the gap in that armour.
You're a long way inside my range.
Third from the left. That's you.
Come closer. Or don't. It's the same to me.
Your friends left. Ask yourself why.
I've buried my own. Burying you costs me nothing.
Wrong day, wrong road, wrong party.
Talk less. Bleed more.
One of us walks away from this. It's usually me.
Put it down and live. ... No? Thought not.
You should have stayed in whatever hole this is.
I have killed {foe.pl} in worse weather than this.

combat_hurt.t: {#curse.cap}, that's blood. That's a lot of blood.
I'm hit! I'm fine. I'm fine.
Is that it? Is that all you've got?
Do that again and I'll take the arm off.
Don't look at it. Don't look at it.
One of you, over here, now!

combat_kill.t: Look at it twitch. Look at it.
Yes! YES! Did you see that?!
I'll take your {$item}. You won't need it.
That's one that won't follow us home.
Off the road. Off my road.
It's not getting up. Check it anyway.
{foe.sg.cap} down! Who's on the next one?
That one had a name, probably.
{$deity.cap} can have the rest of it.
Through the eye. I'll take that one.
Nobody had to bleed for that. Except it.

combat_flee.t: Fall back! Fall back to the {$place}!
I'll come back for you! I will!

ally_down.t: {fallen.name}! No!
{fallen.name}'s down! Somebody— anybody!
They killed {fallen.name}. They killed {fallen.name}!
Hold on, {fallen.name}. Hold on. Look at me.
Leave {fallen.them}! {fallen.they.cap}'s gone!
{fallen.name}... I'll take your {$item}. I'll finish it.
Not {fallen.name}. Anyone but {fallen.name}.
{fallen.name} is down — cover {fallen.them}!
I'm going to {fallen.them}! Hold them off me!
Get {fallen.them} up! I can't reach!
They dropped {fallen.name}. Kill every one of them.
Stay with us, {fallen.name}. That's an order.
No, no — {fallen.name}, look at me. Look at me.
{fallen.name} is breathing. Barely. Buy me a moment.
I saw who did it. That one's mine.
Step over {fallen.them}. Nothing gets past.
Not again. Not another one.
Somebody hold the line while I work!
{fallen.name} went down doing it right. Finish it for {fallen.them}.
If {fallen.they} dies here I am burning this whole place down.

trade_offer.t: I've got {item.a} going cheap. Cheaper than {$person} would give you.
Buying {item.pl}. Good ones. No, that's not a good one.
This {item} belonged to a {$race.sg} of {$place}. Dead now. Won't miss it.
For you, {listener.name}, the {item} at cost. Don't tell {$faction}.
{item.a.cap}, or {$food}? I'll take either for the {$item2}.
Take the {item}. No charge. You need it more than I need the coin.

trade_haggle.t: That's robbery. I've been robbed by {$creature.pl} with more shame.
I'll give you {~six|nine|twelve}, and my silence about the {$person} business.
My {$bodypart} is worth more than that {$item}.
That's a fair price. I don't pay fair prices.
I... could maybe do a little more? If that's all right?
Pay what you can. Pay nothing. I've eaten today.

trade_accept.t: Fine. Fine! You're bleeding me dry, but fine.
A pleasure doing business, {listener.name}. Genuinely. That's rare.
Take it. Take it before I count what it cost me.

trade_refuse.t: I'd sooner throw it in the {$place}.
{#noword}. And I'll be telling {$faction} you tried.
I'm sorry, I can't. I have children. Well, a child. Well, a {$creature}.

grief.t: {fallen.name} is gone. I keep saying it and it keeps being true.
I should have been there. At {$place}. With {fallen.them}.
{fallen.name} owed me {~ten|twenty} {coin.pl}. I'd pay a thousand to be owed again.
We buried {fallen.name} under the {$place}. {fallen.they.cap} hated the {$place}.
Don't say {fallen.name}'s name to me. Don't.
{$deity} took {fallen.name}. I've stopped asking why. I've stopped asking anything.
I still set out {fallen.their} bowl. Stupid. I know it's stupid.
{fallen.name} laughed at everything. Even the {$creature.pl}. Even at the end.

last_words.t: It doesn't hurt. That's a lie. It doesn't matter.
Take my {$item}. Don't let {$faction} have it.
Not... like this. Not in the {$weather}.
Ha. Ha. I really thought... I'd be the one who...
Is that you, mother? It's dark.
Kill them. All of them. For me.
I'm not afraid. I'm not afraid.

warning.t: I saw {foe.a} by the {$place}. A big one. Arm yourselves.
{$faction} riders on the road. They're not here to trade.
Something's wrong with the {$food}. Don't eat the {$food}.
Wake the others. {$deity} help us, wake them all.
Up! Up! They're in the camp!
Don't stare at the fire, you'll be blind out there!
The watch is down. The watch is down!
They're between us and the packs!
That is not the wind. Arm yourselves.

rally.t: On your feet! We are not dying in this {$place}!
They're only {foe.pl}. They bleed. So make them.
Stand with me. Just this once. Just today.
Whoever runs, I'll kill myself. Whoever stands eats first tonight.
Um. We can do this? Probably? Let's do this.

drunk.t: More {$food}! And— and something to drink.
You're my best friend. You. Yes. What's your name?
I loved {$person} once. Or I hated {$person.them}. Something strong.
The {$place}... the {$place}, {listener.name}. I never told anyone what we did there.
I could take a {$creature}. Right now. Where's a {$creature}?
Sing with me! You know the one. About the {$race.sg} and the {$item}.
Everybody dies, {listener.name}. Everybody. Pass the cask.

beg.t: Please. Please, I have {~children|a family|nothing else}.
I'll give you the {$item}. Everything. Just let me go.
Don't. I'll tell you where {$faction} keeps the {$item.pl}.
I'm not asking for me. Just... spare {$person}. Spare {$person.them}.
Kill me if you must. But do it quick. I've earned quick.

pray.t: {god.cap}, I ask nothing for myself. Only {$person}. Only {$person.them}.
{god.cap}, if you're there, I'll settle for a sign. A small one. Any one.
Give me strength. Give me a sharp {$item}. Give me {$creature.pl} to use it on.
{god.cap}. It's me again. Sorry about the {$place}.
Watch over {$person}. And the {$food} stores. And my {$bodypart}.

happy.t: Nobody died today. Nobody. That's a feast day where I'm from.
Feel that? Warm. I'd forgotten warm.

angry.t: If {$person} says one more word about the {$item}, I'll {#bodyharm}.
I'm going to break something. Get out of the way of it.
{$deity} can watch me do this. I don't care.

sad.t: It's nothing. It's the {$weather}. It's nothing.
I dreamt of {$place} again. Everyone was still alive.
What's the point of the {$food}? What's the point of any of it?
{$person} would have known what to say.

worried.t: Something's coming. I can feel it in my {$bodypart}.
Did you bar the door? Check. Check again.
We don't have enough {$food}. We don't. I counted.
{$person} hasn't come back from {$place}. It's been too long.
What if the {$creature.pl} come back? What then? What then?
I can't lose anyone else. I can't.

recall_combat.t: Remember {memory.when}? {foe.count} {foe.pl} at {place.the}. I still smell it.

{memory.when.cap} we fought {foe.count} {foe.pl} at {place.the}. {memory.outcome, select, won{We won, if you can call it that.} fled{We ran. I'm not ashamed.} lost{We lost. Don't ask me more.} other{It was a mess.}}
That fight {memory.ago}. I've stopped counting {foe.pl}, but I counted those.
My {weapon} still has {foe.sg} blood on it from {memory.when}. I'm keeping it there.
{memory.when.cap}, the {foe.pl}. I keep waking up thinking they're at the door.
Ha! {memory.when}, {foe.count} {foe.pl}! I'd do it again tonight.
We should have died at {place.the} {memory.when}. {foe.count} of them. We didn't. Think about why.
{memory.count, plural, one{One fight} other{# fights}} with the {foe.pl} now. They'll come back. They always come back.
{foe.cap.pl}. {memory.when.cap}. I got {memory.wounded, select, true{cut for it} other{lucky}}.

recall_kill.t: I killed {foe.a} {memory.when}. {memory.how.cap}. I'm not proud. I'm not sorry either.
Every {foe.sg} I put down, I remember. {memory.when.cap} was {memory.how}.

recall_death.t: I keep expecting {victim.name} to walk in. It's been {memory.when}. It doesn't get easier.
Don't talk about {victim.name}. Not {memory.when}, not ever.
{victim.name} would've laughed at this. {victim.they.cap} laughed at everything, right up to the {foe.pl}.
{memory.when.cap} {victim.name} died {memory.how}. I promised {victim.them} something. I haven't done it yet.

recall_wounded.t: My {bodypart} still aches from {memory.when}. {foe.cap.a} got a hand in.
{memory.when.cap}, {foe.a} took a piece of my {bodypart} at {place.the}. I took more from it.
I nearly lost the {bodypart} {memory.when}. I still dream about the {foe.pl}.

recall_levelup.t: I've never felt stronger than {memory.when}. Something changed. Something clicked.
{memory.when.cap} I understood something about myself. Don't ask me to explain it.
Level {memory.level}, {memory.when}. Not that I count. I count.
I'm better than I was {memory.when}. I'd like to say it was study. It was mostly surviving.

recall_skill.t: {teacher.name} taught me {skill} {memory.when}. Best thing anyone's given me.
{skill.cap}, {memory.when}. Took me {~a week|three tries|a burned hand} to get it right.
Since {memory.when} I can do {skill}. Ask {teacher.name}, {teacher.they} saw me fail first.

recall_join.t: When {newcomer.name} turned up at {place.the} {memory.when}, I didn't trust {newcomer.them}. {memory.impression.cap}.
{newcomer.name}'s been with us since {memory.when}. Feels longer.

recall_leave.t: I still think about {leaver.name} going, {memory.when}. {memory.why.cap}. Cowards, all of us.
{leaver.name} walked out {memory.when}. I'd have gone too, if I had somewhere.

recall_loot.t: That {item} from {memory.when}? Still got it. Still {memory.worth}.
{memory.when.cap} we pulled {item.a} out of {place.the}. {memory.worth.cap}, and I want my share.
{item.cap.a}, {memory.when}. I gave it to the {$title}. Don't look at me like that.

recall_travel.t: We came through {place.the} {memory.when}. {weather.cap} the whole way.
{memory.when.cap}, {place.the}. I'd not go back without a good reason and a better {$item}.

recall_meal.t: I'm still thinking about the {food} from {memory.when}. {memory.quality.cap}.
{memory.when.cap}: {food}, {memory.quality}. That's the whole story of my life.

recall_insulted.t: {by.name} {memory.what}, {memory.when}. I laughed. I'm still laughing. Inside.
Ask {by.name} what {by.they} said {memory.when}. Go on. See if {by.they} {by.verb(remembers)}.

recall_kindness.t: People say {by.name}'s hard. {by.they.cap} {memory.what} {memory.when}. That's all I need to know.

recall_omen.t: {memory.when.cap} I saw {memory.sign} at {place.the}. {deity.cap} is trying to tell us something.
{memory.sign.cap}, {memory.when}. You can laugh. I'm not laughing.
There was {memory.sign} {memory.when}. Then the {$creature.pl} came. Coincidence, {listener.name}?

recall_lore.t: {figure.name} held {place.the} once. Before your time. Before mine.
They say {figure.name} could {~outdrink a {$race.sg}|talk down a {$creature}|cast {$spell} with a word|make a {$race.sg} weep}. They say a lot.
Ask the {$race.pl} about {figure.name}. Then ask the {$race2.pl}. Two different people.
{figure.name} is buried under {place.the}, or so the {$title.pl} claim.

recall_lineage.t: My {memory.relation} served {figure.name}. We don't talk about how it ended.
{figure.name}'s blood is in my line, through my {memory.relation}. It shows, some days.
My {memory.relation} knew {figure.name}. Said {figure.they} {figure.verb(was)} shorter than the songs.

recall_generic.t: Something happened {memory.when}. I'd rather not go into it.

recall_reply.t: You've told me. {~Twice.|More than once.|Every night.}
I wasn't there. I'm glad I wasn't.
Tell me again. Slowly. I want to remember it right.
Ha. Yes. What a day that was.

observe.t: It's {~too|so} dark in {here.the}. I can't see my own {$bodypart.pl}.
This damp gets into everything. My {$item}'s already rusting.
I don't like walls this close. Or ceilings.
Listen. {scene.sound.cap}. That's all I've heard for an hour.
{here.the.cap}. I've been in worse. I can't think of one right now.
Too many people in here. Watch your purse.
It's loud enough in here to plan a murder.
This is holy ground. Mind your tongue.
Ruins. Somebody's whole life, and now it's a place to hide from the {$weather}.
Out here in the wild, nobody hears you. Nobody helps.
Night. The worst of the {$creature.pl} come out at night.
Look at that {weather}. It's {~lifting|getting worse|just sitting there}.
{here.the.cap}. Fine. Let's get it over with.
Water everywhere. My boots are done for.
Hot as a forge in here.
I could get used to {here.the}. Warm, dry, nobody dying.

fear.t: {threat.cap.pl}. There are {threat.pl} in here. I can feel it.
If the {threat.pl} come at us in here we're finished. Finished.
{threat.count} {threat.pl}, they said. They always say fewer than there are.
I hate {threat.pl}. I hate this place. I hate that I came.
{threat.cap.pl} ambush. That's how they do it. Wait, then all at once.
Keep your {$item} ready. {threat.cap.pl} don't announce themselves.
Something's watching us. {threat.cap.pl}, {threat2.pl}, I don't care which.
{threat.cap.pl}? Ha. Let them come. My {$item} is bored.
{$deity}, if you're listening, no {threat.pl} today. Please.
I want to go home. I don't have a home. I want to go somewhere without {threat.pl}.
Something's wrong here. I can't say what. That's what worries me.
I keep looking over my shoulder. Nothing there. Yet.
My gut says leave. My gut's been right before.

plan.t: We go slow, stay together, and nobody touches anything that glows.
You take the left, I take the right. If you see {threat.a}, shout.
I say we turn back. Nothing in {here.the} is worth a {$bodypart}.
Torches low. {threat.cap.pl} see light before they see us.
Whatever happens, don't run. Running is how the {threat.pl} eat.
We could wait for {~dawn|the {weather} to clear|the others}. Or we could be stupid now.
Kill the {threat.pl} fast, before they scream. A scream brings more.
Let's rest here, if we can. Eat. Then decide.
If I fall, take my {$item} and keep going. Promise me.

relief.t: Warm at last. I'd forgotten what my {$bodypart.pl} felt like.
Nobody's trying to kill us. Enjoy it. It won't last.
{$food.cap}, a fire, and a roof. I'll take it.
Sit. Drink. We earned {here.the}.
I could sleep for a week. I'll settle for an hour.
Listen to that. {scene.sound.cap}. Best sound in the world.
Everyone up? Everyone up. Good.
Closer than I'll admit to later.
Check the bodies, then let's be gone.
My hands have only just stopped.
We're alive. That's the whole of it.
Sit down before you fall down.
Hold still. You're bleeding and pretending you aren't.
Nobody's dying today. I'll take the small win.
I want a fire and no more surprises.
Breathe. In. Out. Again.
Count heads. Then count them again.
We won. Say it back to me, it helps.
The quiet afterwards is the best part of this work.
Right. Loot, water, move.

observe_person.t: You fight well, {listener.name}. I still don't like you.
I'd not turn my back on you. But I'd want you at the front.
You're better than I gave you credit for.
You're soft, {listener.name}. Soft gets people killed.
I don't know what I'd do without you. I mean that.
I owe you, {listener.name}. I pay my debts.
You still owe me for {$place}. Don't think I forgot.
Whatever you want, {listener.name}. Just... whatever you want.
I've seen what you do to people who cross you. I'm not crossing you.
I don't know you. I don't know anyone here.
So. {listener.name}. What is it you actually do?
You'd tell me if something was wrong. Wouldn't you?
Say what you like, I'll believe {$person} before I believe you.
You look... well. You look well, is what I meant.
Sit with me. No reason. Just sit.
You're an idiot, {listener.name}, but you're my idiot.
I've known you {~three winters|too long|since the Maw}. You haven't changed. That's the problem.
You and I are the same kind of bad. That's why we get on.
I'd follow you into {$place}. I wouldn't enjoy it.
Keep your distance, {listener.name}. I mean it kindly. Mostly.
I haven't made up my mind about you, {listener.name}.
You're... fine. That's the most I'll say.

reveal.t: Everyone says you're a coward. I've seen it. I'm not everyone; I'm worse.
You're kind. It's not an insult. It's a warning: they'll use it.
I know what you did with {$faction}'s coin. I haven't told anyone. Yet.
You'd rather bleed than lie. I noticed. It's rarer than you think.
You like the blood. I've seen your face when it starts.
You drink like a man trying to drown something.
You check the door twice. Every night. What happened to you?
You're cruel when you think no one is looking. I'm looking.
You'd die for {$person}. I don't know if that's brave or stupid.
You talk like a book. A long one.
You laugh at everything. I used to think it was stupid. Now I think it's the only sane thing here.
You're still grieving. It's in how you hold your {$item}.
I don't know you well enough to say anything true about you.
I know one thing about you, {listener.name}, and it's enough.
I've watched you. I'm still deciding what I saw.

recall_deed.t: You're {hero.name}, aren't you? The one who {memory.what}. {~Drinks are on me.|About time somebody did.|Half the village doesn't believe it.}
They say {hero.name} {memory.what}{memory.place, select, undefined{} other{ out by {place.the}}}. I say good riddance.
{hero.name}. {memory.when.cap} you {memory.what}. People talk. Some of it is even true.
My cousin saw {hero.name} the day {hero.they} {memory.what}. Won't shut up about it.
If you {memory.what}, you'll do for what's bothering us now.
I heard about the {~cave|hill|bridge|camp}. I heard you {memory.what}. I heard a lot of things about you, {hero.name}.
{hero.name}! The one who {memory.what}! Sit, sit. Tell it again, the way it really happened.

recall_nemesis.t: {memory.name} is still out there. {~I dream about it.|Don't tell me I'm wrong.|That one's mine.}
{memory.when.cap}, {memory.name} put us in the dirt at {place.the}. I have not forgotten the face.

{memory.outcome, select, slain{We finally killed {memory.name}. I'd do it again slower.} escaped{{memory.name} ran. They always run. They always come back.} other{{memory.name}. Say the name and watch my hand shake.}}
If I see {memory.name} again I go first. {~Don't argue.|That's the deal.}
{memory.name}. Twice now. {~Third time somebody dies.|Third time I stay home.}

recall_conversation.t: You said something {memory.when} — "{memory.said}" — I've been thinking about it.
{memory.when.cap} you told me "{memory.said}". {~Still true?|You meant it?}
We talked about this {memory.when}. You said "{memory.said}". {~Well?|And?}

enemy_opener.t: You walked a long way to bleed.
Drop the {$item} and it's quick. Keep it and it isn't.
More bodies for the road, then.
Stand still. It's easier for both of us.
I smelled you before I saw you.
Nobody walks back out of {here.the}. Nobody.
{listener.name.cap}, is it? It won't matter in a moment.
You're late. I've been hungry.
Kill them. Take the boots first — the boots are always the best part.
I was told to leave no witnesses. That's the part I like.
Last chance to turn around. ... No? Good.
You've got the look of people who think they're the heroes here.
{#curse.cap}. More of them.
Blood on the stones before dark. Fine by me.
Try to scream. It carries nicely out here.
Weapons down, or weapons up. I get paid the same.
Shiny! Shiny things and soft {$bodypart.pl}!
We got more! We always got more!
Big ones fall same as little ones. Faster, even.
You got teeth? We collect teeth.
Chief says kill. Chief eats first. Chief is always right!
Eeee! Meat that walks!
Stab the tall one! Stab the tall one first!
Our road. Our road has a toll. The toll is you.
I get the {$item}! I called it! I CALLED IT!
Don't run. Running makes us excited.
Coin, {$item.pl}, boots. Then you can keep the rest.
This road's mine. Been mine since the war.
Nothing personal. We're just hungrier than you are.
Hands where I can see them. Good. Now the purse.
We only kill the ones who argue. Most of them argue.
Pretty {$item}. Be a shame to pull it off a corpse.
You look fed. I hate people who look fed.
Count us. Now count you. Now be sensible.
Put it down. There's two more of us you haven't seen yet.
The last lot begged. Didn't help them either.
The door is opening. You're only noise on the wrong side of it.
You were always going to be here. It was written on the inside of my eyes.
Hold still. The offering is supposed to be whole.
{$deity.cap} does not want your prayers. {$deity.they.cap} wants what's under your skin.
Do you hear it? No? You will, in a moment.
We are not killing you. We are finishing you.
Everything ends. We simply keep the schedule.
Your names are already crossed out.
Kneel, and the knife is kind.
The ones who run make the better screams. Please run.
Warm. You are so very warm.
I remember a name. It might have been mine.
Stop moving. It hurts to watch you move.
Come down here with us. It's quiet down here.
You have breath. Give it back.
We were the garrison. We never left our post.
Flesh. I had that, once.
The grave is not full. The grave is never full.
Don't be afraid. It only hurts until it doesn't.
Everyone joins the watch. Everyone.
Little souls. All of you, walking about unburned.
I have eaten {$race.people}. You won't taste new.
Do you know what the screaming sounds like from my side of it?
Your gods are a rumour here.
I was called up for worse than you. You'll do for now.
Bleed, and I'll know your name. Names are useful.
Come on, then. Bring the little sharp things.
There's a contract with your name at the bottom. I'm collecting.
Fire is honest. Everything else lies.
You'll burn slowly. I do good work.
You are a shape that won't be a shape much longer.
Don't look up. It is already looking back.
Wrong. All of you. Wrong, wrong, wrong.
I was a thought once. I got bigger.
There is no floor under this. There never was.
You count in ones. That is your whole problem.
Stand still and unhappen.
The stars stopped. Nobody told you.
Between your heartbeats there is a very long room.
I'll take the parts of you that matter. There are fewer than you think.
You smell like the last ones. They weren't enough either.
Speak, if you can. Few of you can.
I have slept on better armour than that.
Small. Fast. Loud. Still small.
The hoard is counted. You are not on the list.
I remember your grandfather. He ran, too.
There is no cave deep enough today.
Burn, or be useful. Choose quickly.
Your kind builds. Mine unbuilds. That is the arrangement.
I'll be eating shortly. Do try to be interesting.
Draw. I won't strike an unarmed fool.
The order takes no prisoners. Neither do I.
You stand in a sworn place. Sworn to me.
I have killed better dressed than you.
Name yourself. I like to know what I'm cleaning off the blade.
My oath was to hold this ground. I've held worse.
This isn't courage. This is trespass.
Armour up or bleed out. I don't much care which.
I gave up mercy at the gate. It weighed too much.
One of us kneels today, and it won't be me.

boss_opener.t: So. The noise in the corridors was you.
Come in. Shut the door behind you — you won't be using it.
I let you get this far. I wanted to see your faces.
Every one of my dead is worth ten of you. Come and prove otherwise.
You've killed my people all the way up the stair. Sit. Let's finish it.
I have been waiting here since before your grandmother screamed her first.
There is nothing behind me. This is where it stops.
You brought weapons into my house. That's almost polite.
Do it properly. I'd hate to be disappointed twice in one day.
Kneel, and I'll make the end quick enough to be called kind.
They'll find pieces of you and blame an animal.
I have a name. You won't be using it long enough to wear it out.
Everything you killed to get here was mine, and none of it mattered.
Set down the {$item} or don't. It changes the noise, not the ending.

boss_phase.t: I had hoped to keep this clean.
You've made me work. Nobody has made me work in years.
Let's stop pretending this was ever close.
That hurt. Do you understand what you've just done?
Fine. The careful part is over.
I was holding something back. I'm done holding.
You should have run while running was cheap.
There's a second half to this, and you won't like the shape of it.
Watch the floor. That's all the warning you get.
Every one of you dies in this room. I've stopped negotiating.
Good. Good! Now show me the rest of it!

named_first.t: They'll tell you my name afterwards. Save the trouble and learn it now.
You don't know me yet. That's about to be fixed.
I've been killing on this road since before you could lift {$item.a}.
I heard there were sellswords on the road. I came to see for myself.
{speaker.name}. Say it back, so you know who did it.
New faces. Good. The old ones stopped screaming.
I don't take contracts on nobodies. Somebody paid for you.
Stand where you are and I'll only take the loud one.
You're the ones out of {here.the}? Smaller than the story.
I've been given a list. You're on it, near the bottom.
First time? Try to make it interesting. I get so little.
I take something off everyone I kill. What have you got?

named_rematch.t: You again. I was starting to think you'd died somewhere useful.
Back for the rest of it, then.
I knew you'd follow. People like you always follow.
Still breathing. You've disappointed me {defeats, plural, one{once} other{# times}} now.
I've had {days} days to think about how to do this properly.
We keep meeting. I'm going to fix that.
You ran. I let you. That was a gift, and you've spent it.
The last time was a conversation. This isn't.
New {$item.pl}, I see. They won't help.
Every time I see you there are fewer of you.
Hello again, {listener.name}. Still the loud one.

named_avenge.t: {fallen.name} screamed less than I expected. Let's see about you.
I still have {fallen.name}'s {$item}. Want it back?
You buried {fallen.name} badly. I went and checked.
One of you is already mine. The rest is paperwork.
Say {fallen.name}'s name. Go on. It changes nothing.
{fallen.name} came at me standing exactly where you're standing.
You're angry. Good. Angry people forget their footing.
I took {fallen.name} apart in the time it takes to tell it.
How many more of you do I have to bury before you stop coming?
Your healer couldn't keep {fallen.name} breathing. Let's see about the rest of you.
I kept the {$item} {fallen.name} was holding. It's better than yours.
You should have stopped after I took {fallen.name}. Now I take another.

named_beaten.t: You put me down once. I got up. Try to look impressed.
I've had time to heal, and nothing to do with it but plan.
Last time you were lucky. Luck is a thing that runs out.
You've beaten me {defeats, plural, one{once} other{# times}}. It stops today.
You left me alive. Everyone does that exactly once.
You beat a version of me that doesn't exist any more.
I bled for a week because of you. You'll bleed longer.
Same road. Same faces. Different ending.
You should have finished it. That was the whole job.
I've been practising. On people who looked like you.
I know what you did to the others with names. I'm not the others.
Word travels. You kill the ones the songs are about. Sing about this.

named_beast.t: {foe.sg.cap} doesn't hurry. It has the whole night.
{foe.sg.cap} takes the party in, one at a time, and is unimpressed.
Old scars, badly healed. {foe.sg.cap} has survived worse than you.
Something taught {foe.sg} that people are slow.
{foe.sg.cap} stands over a kill that is neither fresh nor finished.
The rest of them hang back. {foe.sg.cap} eats first.
{foe.sg.cap} has no interest in your weapons. Only your throats.
{foe.sg.cap} waited here for you. That's the part that frightens you.
{foe.sg.cap} has learned to move when the healer looks away.
{foe.sg.cap} has eaten better armed than you, and left the armour.
The ground around {foe.sg} is picked clean for twenty paces.
{foe.sg.cap} came when it heard you coming, not the other way round.

beast_snarl.t: The {foe.sg} lowers its head. Something in its throat clicks.
The {foe.sg} circles wide, cutting off the way back.
Hackles up. The {foe.sg} has done this before.
The {foe.sg} screams — not a hunting sound. A feeding one.
The {foe.sg} drags a foreleg and is still faster than any of you.
Nothing in the {foe.sg}'s eyes takes you for a person.
The {foe.sg} bares teeth stained brown at the roots.
The {foe.sg} sniffs the air and settles on the smallest of you.
The {foe.sg} doesn't roar. It simply comes.
Flies lift off the {foe.sg} in a sheet. It has fed today already.
The {foe.sg} plants itself between the party and the open ground.
A low sound starts up in the {foe.sg} and gets into your teeth.
The {foe.sg} shakes off the rain and picks a target.
The {foe.sg} looks at the {$item} in your hand and is not impressed.
The {foe.sg} opens its mouth wider than a mouth should open.

night_attack.t: The fire gutters. Something is standing just past the light.
The watch never calls out. That's how you know.
{foe.pl.cap} come in low and quiet, from the side without a fire.
Someone's bedroll is empty. Then the screaming starts.
A branch cracks where nobody is walking.
They came for the packs, and they'll take the rest while they're here.
Whatever was circling the camp has stopped circling.
Rain covers the sound of them until they're close enough to touch.
The dark past the fire moves all at once.
You wake with a hand already on your {$item}. Good instincts. Barely enough.
No shouting. Just weight landing on the ground all around you.
The night gives up {foe.a}, then another, then more than you can count.
The last one on watch is face down and still warm.
They waited for the fire to burn low. They're patient, out here.

ambush_opener.t: The trap closes before anyone gets a word out.
They were lying in the ditch on both sides of the road. Of course they were.
The first arrow answers the question of whether anyone is out here.
Something drops out of the branches behind the last of you.
The road ahead is blocked. So is the road behind.
No warning, no demand. They simply come up out of the rocks.
A rope goes taut across the path at knee height.
You're surrounded before anyone thinks to draw.
The quiet was the warning, and nobody read it.
They let the party walk all the way in before standing up.
Whistles from three directions. Then the rush.
Whoever picked this stretch of ground knew exactly what they were doing.
The first you know of it is the sound of a bowstring.
Something heavy lands in the middle of the party and starts swinging.
